✨ About XOXO Avenue

About XOXO Avenue

A simple place to discover people and communities.

💫

What is XOXO Avenue?

XOXO Avenue is a social discovery platform designed to help people discover friendships, communities and connections based on shared interests.

Users can create posts, discover people and find WhatsApp, Telegram and Snapchat connections.

🚀

What you can do

  • Create a personal profile.
  • Discover people with similar interests.
  • Find WhatsApp communities.
  • Find Telegram communities.
  • Share Snapchat-related posts.
  • Create posts and interact with the community.
🛡️

Important

XOXO Avenue is an independent platform and is not affiliated with Snapchat, WhatsApp or Telegram.

XOXO Avenue is designed with safety, privacy and age-appropriate interactions in mind.

Privacy Policy

How XOXO Avenue handles information when you use the service.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

1. About this Privacy Policy

XOXO Avenue is a social discovery platform that helps people meet others, make friends and discover communities. This Privacy Policy explains the types of information XOXO Avenue handles and how that information is used to provide and protect the service.

2. Information you provide

When you create or use a XOXO Avenue account, you may provide information such as your email address, username and profile information. Depending on what you choose to add to your profile, this may include your age, country, languages, interests, what you are looking for, profile photo, bio, gender identity and sexual orientation.

Your exact age is treated as private profile information and is not displayed as part of your public XOXO Avenue profile. Other profile information you choose to provide may be used to help people discover your profile and connect with you.

3. Content and activity

XOXO Avenue handles content and activity you create on the service, including posts, comments, replies, photos, videos, likes, follows, mentions and other interactions. Content you post for the XOXO Avenue community may be visible to other users.

XOXO Avenue also supports saved posts, blocking and reporting. Saved posts are private to your account. Blocking information is used to apply your blocking choices. Reports are used to help review safety or community concerns.

4. Private messages

XOXO Avenue allows users to send direct messages and supported media to one another. Direct messages are intended to be private between the sender and recipient and are handled separately from public posts.

5. How XOXO Avenue uses information

Information may be used to operate XOXO Avenue, authenticate accounts, display profiles and content, provide search and discovery features, deliver messages and notifications, remember user choices, support social features such as follows and likes, respond to reports, prevent abuse, troubleshoot problems and improve the reliability and safety of the service.

6. Public and private information

Some XOXO Avenue features are designed for sharing and discovery. For example, information you choose to include in your discoverable profile, posts, comments and community-related content may be visible to other users. Private features, such as saved posts and direct messages, are handled with access controls appropriate to those features.

Before posting personal information, photos, videos, group links or other content, consider whether you are comfortable sharing it with the people who may be able to view that content.

7. Media and external links

XOXO Avenue allows users to share supported media and may allow links to communities or services such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat or Discord. If you follow a link to another service, that service has its own privacy practices and terms. XOXO Avenue does not control how an external service handles information after you leave XOXO Avenue.

8. Service providers and infrastructure

XOXO Avenue uses third-party technology and infrastructure to operate the service, including Supabase for application services such as account, database and storage functionality, and Cloudflare for web hosting and delivery. Information necessary to operate XOXO Avenue may therefore be processed through these service providers as part of providing the service.

9. Security

XOXO Avenue uses technical access controls and other reasonable measures intended to protect account information and private features. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so users should also protect their passwords and be careful about the information they choose to share.

10. Age requirements

XOXO Avenue is intended for people aged 13 and older. XOXO Avenue does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If XOXO Avenue becomes aware that an account belongs to a child under 13, appropriate steps may be taken regarding the account and associated information.

11. Your choices

You can choose what optional profile information and content to share, use XOXO Avenue's blocking and reporting tools, and contact XOXO Avenue Support with questions about your account or information. If you want to request assistance concerning your account or data, contact the support address below.

12. Changes to this policy

XOXO Avenue may update this Privacy Policy as the service changes. When the policy is updated, the date at the top of this page may be revised.

13. Contact

Questions about this Privacy Policy or your XOXO Avenue account can be sent to xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com.

Terms of Service

Basic terms for using XOXO Avenue.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

1. Using XOXO Avenue

XOXO Avenue is a social discovery platform for meeting people, making friends and discovering communities. By creating an account or using XOXO Avenue, you agree to follow these Terms of Service and the Community Guidelines.

2. Age requirement

XOXO Avenue is intended for people aged 13 and older. You should not use XOXO Avenue if you are under 13.

3. Your account

You are responsible for the activity on your account and for keeping your login information secure. Provide information you are comfortable using on XOXO Avenue and do not use another person's account without permission.

4. Your content

You are responsible for the posts, comments, messages, photos, videos, profile information, community links and other content you share through XOXO Avenue. Only share content you have the right to share, and respect the privacy and rights of other people.

You keep responsibility for your content. By posting content through XOXO Avenue, you allow XOXO Avenue to process, store and display that content as necessary to operate the features where you chose to share it.

5. Respectful and safe use

Do not use XOXO Avenue to harass, threaten, impersonate, scam, spam or harm other people. Do not use XOXO Avenue to share illegal content or content that violates the rights of others. More detailed expectations are described in the Community Guidelines.

6. Reports, blocks and enforcement

XOXO Avenue provides tools that may allow users to report content or accounts and block other users. XOXO Avenue may review reported activity and may remove content, limit access or take action on accounts when necessary to protect the service, users or community.

7. External communities and services

XOXO Avenue may help users discover links or connections involving third-party services such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat or Discord. XOXO Avenue is independent and is not affiliated with those services. Activity that takes place after you leave XOXO Avenue is subject to the rules and practices of the external service involved.

Use care when joining external groups, following links or sharing information with people you meet online.

8. Availability of the service

XOXO Avenue may change, improve, add, remove or temporarily interrupt features as the service develops. XOXO Avenue does not promise that every feature will always be available or operate without interruption.

9. XOXO Avenue name and service

The XOXO Avenue name, design and original service materials belong to XOXO Avenue or their respective rights holders. These Terms do not give users ownership of XOXO Avenue's service, branding or other protected materials.

10. Responsibility and limitations

XOXO Avenue helps people connect but cannot control the behavior, identity, statements or actions of every user or the activities of third-party communities and services. Users are responsible for their own interactions and should use appropriate care when communicating, meeting people or following external links.

11. Changes to these terms

XOXO Avenue may update these Terms as the service evolves. When the Terms are updated, the date at the top of this page may be revised. Continued use of XOXO Avenue after an update means the service will be used under the updated Terms.

12. Contact

Questions about these Terms can be sent to xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com.

Community Guidelines

Help keep XOXO Avenue welcoming, respectful and safe.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

Be respectful

Treat other people with respect. Harassment, bullying, threats and targeted abuse are not welcome on XOXO Avenue.

Keep XOXO Avenue safe

Do not use XOXO Avenue to promote or coordinate illegal activity, scams, sexual exploitation, credible threats of violence or other activity that puts people at serious risk.

No spam or deceptive accounts

Do not repeatedly send unwanted content, manipulate interactions, impersonate another person or create accounts intended to deceive or harm others.

Respect privacy

Do not publish another person's private or sensitive information without permission. Think carefully before sharing your own contact information or other personal details publicly.

Share responsibly

You are responsible for the posts, comments, photos, videos, messages and links you share. Share content you have the right to share and consider who may be able to see it.

Use Block and Report

XOXO Avenue includes tools for blocking users and reporting concerns. Use these tools when appropriate to help protect your experience and bring possible rule violations to XOXO Avenue's attention.

Be careful with external communities

XOXO Avenue can help people discover communities and connections on services such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat and Discord. External groups are not controlled by XOXO Avenue. Be careful with unfamiliar links, requests for personal information and people you have only met online.

Enforcement

XOXO Avenue may review reports and may remove content, restrict features or take action on accounts when activity violates these Guidelines, the Terms of Service or creates a significant safety concern.

Help build a good community

XOXO Avenue is about meeting people, making friends, and discovering communities. Help us keep it welcoming, respectful, and safe for everyone. 💙

Contact

Questions or safety concerns can be sent to xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com.
